text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nobody knows what's gonna happen tomorrow. 
Ain't that right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's why I—— live every single day like 
it's my last run!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
G-Golshi-san!! Now is NOT the time for 
that~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did ya say?! Golshi-chan's Book 
of Quotations is the textbook of life 
itself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look around, we're in a complete do-or-die 
crisis here!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Creature
text_block_list.text: ——EAT... MEAT...! ——Nguluh f'gnaah...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's staring right at us...! Some 
weird creature that looks like an 
octopus-snake hybrid...! We're its target, 
aahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, we came all the way out 
to this deserted island, so where the heck 
is the monster guarding the treasure?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I gotta snatch the treasure from it and 
fund the first-ever horse girl expedition 
to the South Pole! C'mon, get out here, ya 
bastard!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's literally right in front of us, isn't 
it?! That's totally the rumored monster! 
Just looking at it makes my head spin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's just a wild dog. I'm bored, 
let's head back. Race ya to the canoe~!

text_block_list.name: Wild Dog?
text_block_list.text: ——PREY... RAN! ——Yog Nyarl'ygg!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!! It's chasing after us!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the two of them say they were going 
on an "adventure," I casually offered to 
chaperone them. But, I never imagined we'd 
end up on an uninhabited island——
choice_data_list: This really is a grand adventure...
This really is a grand adventure...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, sorry to keep ya waiting! Took a bit 
of effort to scatter those octopus 
wieners, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san!! Hurry, launch the boat!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: HURRY!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wheeeew! We somehow managed to get away.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even so, why on earth did you try to go to 
such a dangerous place?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"'Cause I felt like it!" ——That's the 
whole reason!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, the sun might get a makeover 
into a red giant and swallow the Earth 
whole! And when that happens!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The "tomorrow" in "I'll do it tomorrow" 
WON'T EXIST!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," "later," and "another 
opportunity" are all totally at the mercy 
of the universe's whim of the day!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell am I turning into ashes 
while regretting, "Man, I chickened out 
and skipped going to Treasure Island 
yesterday..."!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really do live every day like it's 
your last run, don't you...?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Living without regrets... I guess that's 
what it truly means, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will etch Golshi-chan's Book of 
Quotations deep into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heheh, cut it out, you're makin' me blush.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, about the candidate for the next 
Treasure Island——

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That is a completely different matter! 
Please, let's stop these dangerous 
adventures already!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Life is one big dangerous adventure until 
the day you kick the bucket. That's what 
makes it so damn fun!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout you, Trainer?! Wearing your 
big-kid pants for a grand adventure with 
the fate of the world on the line?
choice_data_list: Well, maybe whenever I feel like it...

I have a bad feeling about this. Let's 
not.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Your resolve has been duly noted...! Let's 
roll! To protect this green Earth of ours!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-They got dragged away. I wonder if 
they'll really be okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, I was dragged all over the place 
by Gold Ship, embroiled in a grand, 
chaotic adventure.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tch, boring.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I forgot something on that island from 
earlier, gonna go grab it real quick.
choice_data_list:
I can't let you go alone... Guess I have 
no choice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehh! You're planning to go back to that 
island?! You really, really shouldn't——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
——I don't remember much of what happened 
that day. Only the distinct memory of 
encountering something indescribable on 
that island remains...
